# TeachMeIDEA

> > Software development tutorials and guides focusing on Flutter, AWS, Python frameworks, and modern web technologies

TeachMeIDEA provides practical tutorials for developers working with mobile development (Flutter, Dart), cloud services (AWS), backend frameworks (FastAPI, Django, Flask), and modern development practices. Created by Owen Carry, the site emphasizes real-world applications and best practices.

## Key Topics

- Flutter
- Dart
- AWS (EC2, Lambda, S3)
- Python frameworks (FastAPI, Django, Flask)
- Mobile development
- State management
- Clean architecture
- GraphQL and Apollo Server
- Redis data structures
- Code review best practices
- i18n/l10n internationalization
- Testing best practices
- DevTools
- Cloud security and performance

## Getting Started

- [Welcome to TeachMeIDEA: Learn Software Development](https://teachmeidea.com/about): About page for TeachMeIDEA: Flutter, Dart, and mobile dev tutorials

## Cloud & Backend Development

- [AWS for Developers: The Services You Actually Need to Know](https://teachmeidea.com/aws-for-developers-essential-services): Pragmatic AWS guide: EC2, Lambda, and essential services for developers
- [AWS S3 Best Practices: Security, Performance, and Cost](https://teachmeidea.com/aws-s3-best-practices): AWS S3 best practices: security, IAM, KMS encryption, and cost optimization
- [Flask vs FastAPI vs Django in 2025: Performance Review](https://teachmeidea.com/flask-vs-fastapi-vs-django-in-2025): Python framework comparison: Flask vs FastAPI vs Django performance in 2025
- [GraphQL Servers with Apollo and Express Performance Tips](https://teachmeidea.com/graphql-servers-with-apollo-and-express): GraphQL with Apollo Server and Express: schemas, resolvers, performance tips
- [Redis Data Structures and Their Real-world Applications](https://teachmeidea.com/redis-data-structures-beyond-caching): Redis Lists, Sets, and Sorted Sets for real-time coordination and queues

## Flutter & Mobile Development

- [Internationalisation & Localisation (i18n/l10n) in Flutter](https://teachmeidea.com/internationalisation-localisation-i18n-l10n-in-flutter): Flutter i18n/l10n guide: ARB files, multi-language support, RTL configuration

## Development Best Practices

- [Code Review Best Practices to Enhance Code Quality](https://teachmeidea.com/code-review-best-practices-giving-receiving-feedback): Code review best practices: giving and receiving feedback effectively
